UI-kit-built landing page: 79 component instances and 148 vectors nested inside 88 clipping frames, with 12 gradient fills and 18 partially transparent layers.

Full 1440x960 product dashboard — sidebar, metric cards, charts, table. Auto-layout in both directions and heavily nested: 199 HORIZONTAL / 97 VERTICAL / 76 NONE, 0 wrap, 10 levels deep, over 524 nodes with 244 component instances, 126 FILL-sized and 291 HUG-sized children.
1440x1315 dashboard variant with a scrolled content column: 189 HORIZONTAL / 84 VERTICAL / 66 NONE auto-layout, 10 deep, 493 nodes, 246 instances, 106 FILL and 238 HUG children.

375x2366 mobile settings screen — the vertical-dominant counterpart to app-untitled-ui-settings, and the only case where VERTICAL outnumbers HORIZONTAL: 50 HORIZONTAL / 68 VERTICAL / 44 NONE, 13 deep, 253 nodes, 134 FILL children stretching to a 375px viewport.

1216x899 data table assembled from cell instances — the horizontal-dominant extreme: 283 HORIZONTAL / 29 VERTICAL / 55 NONE, 6 deep, 509 nodes of which 325 are instances, 105 FILL and 304 HUG children. Column widths come entirely from HUG/FILL resolution, so any sizing error shifts every column.

375x8925 mobile marketing page — the tallest frame in the corpus relative to width (23.8:1). 161 HORIZONTAL / 125 VERTICAL / 71 NONE, 9 deep, 579 nodes, 192 instances, 221 FILL children, 82 vectors and 11 image fills.

1440x6734 second desktop landing page, vector-heavy where the first is instance-heavy: 143 VECTOR nodes across 158 HORIZONTAL / 91 VERTICAL / 93 NONE auto-layout frames, 10 deep, 598 nodes, 142 FILL and 339 HUG children.
